errors.evidence: While the figure caption mentions a survey, the chart itself does not explicitly state that the data comes from a survey. This is an interpretation of external context rather than a direct description of the visual content.
The description omits a part of the category label. The full label on the chart is "Прекъсване на конкуренцията / пазара".
The chart does not contain a category named "Неустойчиво пазара". This seems to be a hallucinated category, possibly from a misinterpretation of "Прекъсване на конкуренцията / пазара".
The chart label is "Действия на акционера" (Shareholder actions), not "Интегриране на акциите" (Integration of shares). This is a significant mistranslation of the category label.

errors.evidence: The value for "Финансови / ликвидност" is approximately 23%, not 25%.
The values for "Тероризъм" and "Други" are approximately 5%, not 2%.
The description omits several categories shown in the chart, including "Технологичен провал", "Неизправност", "Природно бедствие", "Неизправност на продукта", "Социални медии", and others.
